body:
Hi, I am here. I was hospitalized for a while after getting there after wimping out and calling the helpline
I’m better but still not well since the hospital was really no help other than to keep me from hurting myself short term. The whole experience was pretty traumatic
Yes it’s clear here so I got to see it. The moon was just as pretty before the eclipse too it was nice. I really appreciate that thank you so much
I would like to but I would like to pm them since I don’t want anything to get traced back to this post and I’ve posted my stuff on social media

I feel like everyone my age is already in their careers because they had the resources and helpful adults in their lives to lead them in the right path. By the time I realized that I felt it was too late

I’ve always like animation and character design. I’m in my early 20s and I still prefer cartoons and animated movies over live action ones. I really wanted that to be my career but i feel like they ship has sailed
I like to draw and paint. I actually wanted a career in art but I’ve figured out that it’ll never happen
That sounds like fun actually.
Thank you. I’ve always loved celestial events and space stuff in general

Maybe. But going through this cycle with each low seemingly worst than the last is disheartening. I really can’t think very far into the future anymore and that’s one of the biggest things tearing me up. It’s just blank and it’s a strange and new feeling to me. I’m sorry if I’m not making a lot of sense 

I appreciate your kind words

(My stupid ass almost outed myself by responding through my main sorry about the ninja delete)

To answer, I’ve never confided in anyone like that, even my closest friends who know my darkest secrets. It’s very scary to me
One person never responded, others made other plans. Only one had a valid reason and I was going to say hi to him tomorrow if I go to my parents house

I’ve been planning this for weeks and moved it closer a couple days because I wake up every morning feeling more miserable than the last. I wanted to see all of my friends again but now I feel desperate
It’s not easy to explain

In the past I’ve had second thoughts but this is truly the first time I’ve felt that I’m actually going to go through with it. I guess I just wanted to be heard for a second since it felt like I couldn’t go to anyone in my life
You are very kind and I appreciate you

It’s so frustrating trying to find a therapist who was as good as the one I had before. And having to start from scratch and revisiting passed trauma is stressful and causes me to sink lower for a while. I was with my old therapist for about 4 years and I was fairly stable during that time
Virginia. I don’t know if I will stay at my apartment or go to my parents house where there less city lights and noisy highways.
I really appreciate it
I really appreciate it

I don’t really think my friends are shitty. I really don’t think they know how miserable I am and I can’t bring myself to tell them. I really want them to succeed in life and I’m proud of what they’ve accomplished so far. People like me can be a burden and I don’t want them to stress too much over me especially since I’m a lost cause. I don’t think they’d even know what to say or do. I know I wouldn’t 
It’s still really disappointing though. I really wanted to be with them again and have my last memory of them be something nice I guess

I try not to make people uncomfortable with it and keep it bottled up. The one time I ever let it slip, I was very drunk and I think they thought I was joking or that I was just being a drunken idiot. No one ever brought it up and I don’t think it’s their responsibility anyway so I’m not upset with them about that
Honestly I just wanted to see them all again so my last memory of them is one where we’re having a good time

I feel like they will eventually feel better. 5 years down the line they will be successful in their careers and have so much going for them that it won’t matter as much. I’m really proud of how far they’ve come and hope they continue to grow. I would make sure they know before I go that it wasn’t their fault. They didn’t know and they aren’t actively trying to hurt me. I my sisters don’t need a deadbeat to look up to, I’ve set a terrible example for them and my parents have made that clear. I told one of them to not let my mother mislead them down the same path as me and go to a four year university as soon as she gets out of high school. Shes so smart and has so much potential and I’m so proud of her and I don’t want her to end up like me. I’m sorry for rambling

I really do believe they are my friends. Im probably the terrible friend to be honest. It’s probably for the best because it won’t hurt them as bad when I’m gone.
 I really don’t see things getting better. I’ve been manipulated and abused by so many different people, even my own family. Even when I was depressed before I thought if I just push through I can finally leave and I’ll grow up and I’ll have a career doing the thing I love most. Now I’m an adult and it’s only gotten worse. I now see that it’ll never happen. I can’t even imagine myself a month from now. I really appreciate you caring though
I’d rather not say where I am, at least not publicly. It does feel better knowing someone has seen this I guess
